sections.text: DIRECTOR OF FINANCE RECEIVED SEP 2005 METROPOLITAN GOVERN 5 E AND DAVIDSON COUNTY DIRECTOR OF FINANCE BILL. PURCELL METRO CITY HALL MAYOR 225 POLK AVENUE. SUITE 250 NASHVILLE, TENNESSEE 37203 September 7, 2005 (615) 862-6156 FAX NDMC c/o Nashville Downtown Partnership Attn: Executive Director, Tom Turner 150 4" Avenue North Suite G-150 Nashville, TN 37219 Dear Mr. Turner: The contract between the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County and the Nashville District Management Corporation Inc., for administration of the Central Business Improvement District, will expire on December 31, 2005, unless it is renewed prior to November 1, 2005. Pursuant to Section 4(b) of the Contract, this letter is to serve as the Metropolitan Government’s written notice of renewal for an additional year. In order for the Contract to be extended past December 31, 2005, so as to expire on December 31, 2006, NDMC’s Executive Director needs to sign and return this letter as indicated below to: Ashley Daugherty, Metropolitan Attorney, Department of Law, 225 Polk Avenue, Suite 210, Nashville, TN 37203, prior to November 1, 2005. If NDMC does not wish to renew the Contract past December 31, 2005, then of course do xot sign and return this letter. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. avid Zee Director of Finance On behalf of the Nashville District Management Corporation, Inc. (“NDMC”), I hereby give notice of a one-year renewal of the contract with the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County for the administration of the Central Business Improvement District. py. This 2005. Tom Turner RECEIVED Executive Director, NDMC OCT 1 8 2005
